The quick form of [CopyPixel](CopyPixel). Both buffers must be locked with [LockBuffer](LockBuffer) first, and the position is not checked against the edges of the original.
@param src_x        Horizontal position of the pixel to copy.
@param src_y        Vertical position of the pixel to copy.
@param src_buffer   The locked buffer to copy from.
@param dest_x       Horizontal position to copy to.
@param dest_y       Vertical position to copy to.
@param dest_buffer  The locked buffer to copy to. Defaults to the current buffer.
@gap A buffer that is not locked is ignored by a build without `-d`, and stops a debug build (`-d`) with an error message. Positions outside of a buffer are ignored instead of writing into other memory like the original could.
@gap Pixels are copied with all the bits that the buffers have: a buffer made by [Graphics3D](Graphics3D) with the depth 64 does not lose anything on the way. See [Color depth](Color-Depth).
